subject: Enablement concierge: session map, recordings & action items
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@acmeanalytics.com>, Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@acme.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Enablement concierge: session map, recordings & action items

Hi Sara / Michael —

Thanks again for the productive kickoff last week. Per our handoff checklist, we'd like to run a compact enablement sprint next week (two live sessions + one office hours drop-in) and then share recordings + a single-sheet runbook for your platform team. Draft agenda and ask: 

- Tuesday 2027-02-16, 14:00-15:15 UTC — Platform deep-dive (API auth, VPC setup, telemetry hooks) — target audience: infra/ops
- Thursday 2027-02-18, 16:00-17:00 UTC — Product walkthrough & prompt engineering patterns — target audience: product/ML
- Friday 2027-02-19, 15:00-16:00 UTC — Office hours (open Q&A, live lab access)

Attachments: enablement_agenda_v1.pdf (short agenda), session-deck-apis.pptx (API-focused deck).

Could you confirm (1) the attendee list for infra vs product, and (2) whether the VPC owners want pre-call access to the sandbox (we can provide ephemeral creds)? If those times don't work, propose two time slots and we'll accommodate.

Next steps from our side: Ben will host the API deep-dive; Jordan will coordinate invites and recording access; Evelyn will collect final action owners.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

--- Attachment: enablement_agenda_v1.pdf (1 page, agenda summary)
--- Attachment: session-deck-apis.pptx (pptx, 28 slides)

From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@acme.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Enablement concierge: session map, recordings & action items

Marissa — thanks, this looks great. A few quick notes from our side: 

1) Attendees: Platform (VPC/infra) = Michael O'Neill, Priya Singh (networking), Tom Reyes (security). Product/ML = myself, Lina Gomez (ML), Raj Patel (product).
2) VPC sandbox: we would like pre-call access to the sandbox credentials so our networking team can validate routing rules ahead of the deep-dive. Can you provide ephemeral keys and an ingress test plan?
3) Recording access: please make sure recordings are downloadable for internal training.

Also, can you include a 15-minute slot in the API session to discuss token rotation and KMS integration? That's a blocker for our security review.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Khan
Head of Platform, Acme Analytics
sara.khan@acmeanalytics.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 17:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Enablement concierge: session map, recordings & action items

All — quick internal notes for the API deep-dive based on Sara's asks: 

- I'll add a 15-minute KMS/token rotation segment at the end of the API talk and include sample code for automatic rotation and RBAC matrices.
- For sandbox access: we'll provision an ephemeral service account with scoped creds and a short-run test script (curl + health check). I will attach the test plan and the sandbox onboarding doc to the session calendar.
- Recording options: we'll record to our internal recorder and also push a copy to the shared Drive link (download enabled) and a trimmed version for the product team.

Action items (internal):
- Ben: deliver sandbox test plan + code snippets by Wed EOD (att: session-deck-apis.pptx update).
- Jordan: confirm invites and create calendar with meeting notes + Drive folder.
- Marissa: confirm attendee teams and follow-up with Sara for any special compliance requests.

I'll take point on running the API lab live; plan is to provision ephemeral creds 24 hours before the session.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Sara Khan <sara.khan@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Enablement concierge: session map, recordings & action items

Thanks team — nice momentum. A few coordination notes for the enablement handoff and post-session artifacts: 

- Recording map: Jordan please produce a CSV with timestamped segments (API auth, VPC steps, prompt patterns, Q&A) and attach to the HubSpot deal record. This makes the replay consumable for different audiences.
- Single-sheet runbook: we should produce a 1-page "Day 0" and a 1-page "Ops checklist" (two artifacts). I'll draft the Day 0 by Fri morning.
- Ownership: list owners in the calendar invites so Acme knows who to ping for follow-ups.
- Escalation path: if Acme's security team raises any blocking KMS items during the review, route to me + our security partner (secops@redwood.ai).

Sara — we'll provision sandbox creds by Wed 17:00 UTC and share the test plan. If you want the creds sooner for automation testing, tell us and Ben will expedite.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai

Hi Sara / Michael —

Thanks everyone — sessions went well. Quick deliverables we're sharing now: 

1) Recording index (CSV) — contains timestamps for key segments and download links: recording-index.csv attached.
2) Sandbox test plan + ephemeral creds (delivered via secure link in separate email).
3) Single-sheet runbooks: Day-0-runbook.pdf and Ops-checklist.pdf (placed in shared Drive).
4) Action items (owners):
   - Ben: follow-up on KMS integration sample code (ETA: Tue Feb 23).
   - Marissa: coordinate security questionnaire answers and provide SOC2 artifacts (ETA: Wed Feb 24).
   - Evelyn: schedule a 30-min exec sync after security signoff to review rollout plan (TBD).

If you need separate copies for your SAML/team training channel, let me know and we will export.

Best,
